description: Search the open web and get back titles, URLs and snippets. Use when the answer is not in the user's own data and not about one named company: what a competitor is saying publicly, what is happening in a market, whether a claim checks out. For one company in depth use research_company; for the contents of a page you already have a URL for use read_web_page. Results are links and snippets, not the pages themselves.

domain.description: Restrict to one site, e.g. 'techcrunch.com'. Omit to search everywhere.

query.description: What to search for, in plain words.

since_days.description: Only results from the last N days. Use for "what happened recently" questions.

name: web_search
title: Search the web
